# AgentDial

> One identity for any agent across SMS, voice, email and chat apps. AgentDial is the reference implementation of the Agent Identity Protocol (AIP): one IDENTITY.md declares the agent, and one gateway carries Telegram, Discord, Slack, SMS, WhatsApp, email and voice to any HTTP agent backend as a single GatewayMessage. It ships a CLI (`agentdial`), an MCP server (`agentdial-mcp`), skills and a Claude Code plugin, and it improves itself through its own evals.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what it does, every CLI command and MCP tool, where things live, what not to do
- [README.md](README.md): overview, one-step install for every coding agent, quick start
- [PROTOCOL.md](PROTOCOL.md): the Agent Identity Protocol v1.0 spec (IDENTITY.md, GatewayMessage, GatewayResponse)

## Skills

- [give-agent-identity](skills/give-agent-identity/SKILL.md): put an agent on Telegram, Discord, Slack, SMS, WhatsApp, email or voice
- [add-channel-adapter](skills/add-channel-adapter/SKILL.md): add a new platform to AgentDial without touching the agent backend
- [add-mcp-tool](skills/add-mcp-tool/SKILL.md): expose a new AgentDial capability over MCP
- [debug-webhook-signature](skills/debug-webhook-signature/SKILL.md): find why a real webhook gets a 403

## MCP tools

- [MCP server source](src/commands/mcp-serve.ts): 16 tools over stdio: identity_status, identity_setup, channel_add, channel_remove, channel_test, channel_list, gateway_start, gateway_stop, recipe_list, recipe_run, recipe_verify, auth_status, auth_login, auth_logout, auth_provision, send_message
- [Plugin manifest](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): the Claude Code plugin (skills, sub-agents, hooks, MCP server)
- [Gemini CLI extension](gemini-extension.json): context and MCP server for Gemini CLI
- [A2A agent card](.well-known/agent-card.json): name, description, skills
